POWER MECHANICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #7
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Motor Vehicle Chassis, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Motor Vehicle Chassis.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Motor Vehicle Chassis.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Motor Vehicle Chassis.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Motor Vehicle Chassis.

2. When learning Evolution of motor vehicles, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Evolution of motor vehicles.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Evolution of motor vehicles.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Evolution of motor vehicles.

   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
